DeterminationBasis: The existing T01 cases establish complete state, scope, applicable identity and fail-closed missing predicates, but none directly requires the Governing State Object to identify the authority relied upon or explicitly represent authority as NOT_ESTABLISHED. Explicit authority-state representation therefore remains a distinct test obligation.

The existing T01 cases do not directly require standing and admissibility to be explicitly represented within the Governing State Object when those properties are applicable. The same structural-state test can inspect explicit authority, standing and admissibility representations without creating overlapping separate tests.
